selection: Purposive capability-gap sampling of authorized open-access records, not an exhaustive systematic review or PRISMA flow

queries.query: (TITLE_ABS:electrocatalysis OR TITLE_ABS:electrocatalytic) AND (TITLE_ABS:"best practices" OR TITLE_ABS:quantification OR TITLE_ABS:"Tafel" OR TITLE_ABS:"solvation kinetics")
(TITLE_ABS:"carbon dioxide reduction" OR TITLE_ABS:"CO2 reduction") AND (TITLE_ABS:kinetic OR TITLE_ABS:operando OR TITLE_ABS:microenvironment OR TITLE_ABS:water)
(TITLE_ABS:electrocatalysis OR TITLE_ABS:electrocatalytic) AND (TITLE_ABS:fullerene OR TITLE_ABS:"molecular catalyst" OR TITLE_ABS:"constant potential")
(TITLE_ABS:"oxygen evolution" OR TITLE_ABS:"oxygen reduction") AND (TITLE_ABS:isotope OR TITLE_ABS:kinetic OR TITLE_ABS:mechanism OR TITLE_ABS:"active site")

local_recent_pdf_check: Two apparently new local JACS PDFs matched existing DOI identities and were excluded
final_deduplication: An additional manually chosen candidate was found to duplicate E017 at final validation; its extra re-review was excluded from new count and replaced with DOI10.1038/s42004-024-01151-0. Import now rejects any prior/batch canonical DOI duplicate before writing.
bias: OA availability, database coverage, journal filter and top100 retrieval per query introduce selection bias. No claim of all top-journal coverage.
